name: dist_broadcast
comment: bugs/stats/distribution-array-params.md (cycle 29: normal + exponential). The *pdf/*cdf/*inv functions broadcast ARRAY distribution parameters (mu/sigma), not just the data x: scalar expands, equal sizes element-align, mismatched non-scalar sizes error ('Non-scalar arguments must match in size.'), shape follows the non-scalar operand (npS is 2x2). Per-element domain: sigma<=0 / mu<=0 -> NaN (np5(2), ep6(2) are NaN, fingerprinted around them). normpdf/normcdf/exppdf/expcdf/expinv match MATLAB to ~1e-15; norminv is limited to ~1e-11 by erfinvScalar's Newton convergence (pre-existing), so spec tol is 1e-9. 'upper' flag works under broadcast (eu1). Discrete + remaining continuous families (gam/beta/chi2/t/f/rayl/wbl/logn, bino/poiss/...) land in later cycles -- md stays OPEN. Matches MATLAB R2025b.
